fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Master switch. When off, the webhook ignores events (it still answers Meta's GET verification).

fields.label: Auto Draft
fields.description: Generate an AI draft for each new inbound message.

fields.label: Alert After (Minutes)
fields.description: Push moderators when a customer has waited this long.

fields.label: Moderators
fields.description: Who receives chat pushes. Empty means every enabled user with the Moderator role.

fields.label: Mask Personal Data
fields.description: Replace phone numbers, emails, links and the customer's name before anything is sent to the AI.

fields.label: Default POS Profile
fields.description: Menu and price list source for the AI drafts.

fields.label: Brand Instructions
fields.description: Tone and policy notes appended to the AI system prompt.

fields.label: Planted Draft %
fields.description: 0 to 20. Share of drafts deliberately made wrong, as a training check for moderators.

fields.label: Upsell Items
fields.description: The ONLY items the AI may suggest as an upsell.

fields.label: Ready Answers
fields.description: Jarz's saved replies (menu, prices, offers, delivery areas...). The AI adapts the matching one instead of improvising. The built-in defaults stay unless you override them: a row with the same Topic replaces that default, an inactive row with that Topic removes it, and a new Topic is added. Placeholders such as {{menu}}, {{offers}}, {{delivery_areas}} and {{price:ITEM_CODE}} are filled live.

fields.label: Meta App Secret
fields.description: Key for the X-Hub-Signature-256 webhook signature.

fields.label: Webhook Verify Token
fields.description: Must match hub.verify_token on Meta's GET verification.

fields.label: Page Access Token
fields.description: Used for Messenger, Instagram and comments.
